notes: No-argument command emits the default bit list; C sprintbit preserves its trailing space before the final LFCR (R1/R2/R5e/R5h).
The empty bitvector uses C sprintbit's "NOBITS " result (R1/R5e/R5h).
An unknown first token emits the invalid-mode preamble and the full mode list with C's trailing space (R1/R2/R5e/R5h).
An already-set SHOW_ON bit emits the exact refusal (R1/R2/R5e/R5h).
An already-set SHOW_OFF bit emits the exact refusal (R1/R2/R5e/R5h).
